Baseline: dead `Some(port) != url.port_or_known_default()` comparison in `dedupe_key_for` (clip_url.rs:90) and `display_url` (intent.rs:119); `port()` already strips scheme-default ports so the condition was never true. Verified: just docs-check green, capture_flag_guard lib tests 9/9 pass, just check green. Guard behavior unchanged; target task bob-cli-c4 left open for lander.

payload.entry: LANDER VERIFY (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.land). All 5 phases were reviewed against their notes and source; no phase recorded a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP. Phase .1, 7e8ffedd: dedupe_key_for and display_url keep url.port(), with tests; closed c3. Phase .2, 633bc3f6: TEXT help corrected in 5 commands and CLI docs regenerated; closed c4. Phase .4, 3eebe47f: raw-PDF fallback removed and pdftotext gated; closed 9i. Phase .5: 4k was already closed done by the phase with a 4-pass macOS CI evidence chain, re-confirmed via gh (461f46c run 40195734261 success, still the newest master run). Phase .3, 89945148: the ref doctor reference-ids row, decided IMPLEMENT. EPIC-CAUSED DEFECT FIXED: the new repair test needed pandoc, and CI run 40202985199 on 89945148 failed on ubuntu and macOS. Fixed in ba523746 with a marker-PDF plus ref sync setup; doctor_library is 15/15 with and without pandoc. INTEGRATION, also in ba523746: duplicate-id folding switched to ASCII to match the docs and resolve.rs; the CLI Mermaid render-only tests are no longer pdftotext-gated (lib 19/19 and CLI 12/12 with pdftotext hidden); the redundant pdftotext check was dropped; docs/capture.md saved_templates_unknown_flag wording was fixed. Gates: just check 18 suites, 5657 passed, 0 failed; just docs-check passed. Release run 40202947018 failed only on a non-fast-forward push race (master advanced mid-run); the next scheduled train retries. b8 stays OPEN: the code half is done, but the live-vault repair is forbidden by the working rules and goes to batch 11 behind a Bryan-approved /sase_gate (see the b8 note). DRIFT: fd0fc2e5 (docs refresh) reported 3 source follow-ups. The port and capture-help ones are fixed by this epic. The Day strip openStatsForDay newLeaf defect was confirmed in bob-plugins 3bac436 and filed via /sase_new_task as bob-cli-c6 (bug, small), with no duplicate and related, not caused, to active epic bob-cli-c5. 0cf45b8c (homes rollup retirement) does not overlap this epic. epic-symbols: none. No symvision recipe exists.

LANDER ADDENDUM: while preparing the batch-11 b8 phase, the lander found a second epic-caused defect in 89945148. id_stem_mismatch flagged the decision-allowed <stem>_N duplicate-avoiding suffix that bob ref rename itself allocates (tests/cli/ref_library/rename.rs colliding_reference_ids_receive_the_first_available_suffix), so the advised same-stem repair could never clear it. Fixed in 41cd3748: the suffix is accepted while another note records <stem>, with a new doctor_library test and a docs/highlights-ref-sync.md update. Verified with just check (5658 passed, 0 failed) and just docs-check. A read-only bob ref list on the live vault now shows 1 duplicate id (BryanBugyi_CV_extended x2) and 2 mismatches (BryanBugyi_CV_extended_v2, obsidian_sync_footprint_audit_bob-cli-1l). ref/papers/harness_engineering.md (id harness_engineering_2 next to ref/blogs/harness_engineering.md) is decision-compliant.

Deferred: 8r (root-level athena hardening), c6 (waits for active epic bob-cli-c5 on openStatsForDay), 5m/5n (sase-tool defects), v (resized scope noted on the bead), large flakes 5o/b9/67 (no root cause).
